paragraphs: He and Mar Zutra, the sons of Rav Mari bar Isur, divided their property and came before Rav Ashi: Kiddushin 65b. Seder HaDorot reads Rav Acha Saba.[^1]

notes.text: Kiddushin 65b names Mar Zutra and Rav Ada Saba as sons of Rav Mari bar Isur. The Rav Acha reading attributed to Seder HaDorot remains Hyman’s reported variant.
